## Philosophy

I view teaching and research as deeply interconnected, with both grounded in curiosity, rigor, and collaboration. In the classroom, I encourage students to apply social science theories to their own experiences, fostering critical thinking and a sense of ownership. My goal is to create an inclusive environment where students from all backgrounds feel empowered to contribute, grow, and see themselves as part of the scholarly community.
